tooltip.chronoarsenal.chrono_blade.passi: Hits slow time for the target and leave a Temporal Echo that strikes again 1s later
tooltip.chronoarsenal.chrono_blade.use: Right-click: TIME STOP - freeze everything within 12 blocks for 5s (30s cooldown)
tooltip.chronoarsenal.chrono_blade.sneak: Sneak + Right-click: REWIND - return to where you were 5s ago and undo lost health (45s cooldown)
tooltip.chronoarsenal.plasma_repeater.lo: "Warning: barrel reaches the temperature of a star."
tooltip.chronoarsenal.plasma_repeater.pa: Bolts ignite targets. The bar under the icon is HEAT - hit 100% and it overheats
tooltip.chronoarsenal.plasma_repeater.sn: Sneak while firing: OVERCHARGE - stronger bolts, double heat
tooltip.chronoarsenal.graviton_maul.pass: Hits launch enemies upward. Hitting an airborne enemy deals bonus damage
tooltip.chronoarsenal.graviton_maul.use: Right-click: SINGULARITY - a 3s black hole that pulls everything in, then implodes (20s cooldown)
tooltip.chronoarsenal.graviton_maul.snea: Sneak + Right-click: REPULSOR - blast enemies away and reflect projectiles (8s cooldown)
tooltip.chronoarsenal.rift_edge.lore: "The shortest path between two points is a tear."
tooltip.chronoarsenal.rift_edge.passive: Hits have a 20% chance to rip the target through space
tooltip.chronoarsenal.rift_edge.use: Right-click: PHASE BLINK - dash 14 blocks, slashing everything in the way (2.5s cooldown)
tooltip.chronoarsenal.rift_edge.sneak: Sneak + Right-click: VOID SWAP - trade places with the creature you look at (5s cooldown)
tooltip.chronoarsenal.arc_caster.passive: Wet targets (rain or water) take 50% more damage
tooltip.chronoarsenal.arc_caster.use: Right-click: CHAIN LIGHTNING - an arc that jumps between up to 6 enemies
tooltip.chronoarsenal.arc_caster.sneak: Sneak + Right-click: STORM CALL - real lightning where you look, with arcs to everything nearby (10s cooldown)
